mapper.insert: insert into trading.fund_account ( id, account_no, user_identity_code, subject_name, account_role, available_balance, total_recharge_amount, total_debit_amount, total_income_amount, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{accountNo}, #{userIdentityCode}, #{subjectName}, #{accountRole}, #{availableBalance}, #{totalRechargeAmount}, #{totalDebitAmount}, #{totalIncomeAmount}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: select id, account_no, user_identity_code, subject_name, account_role, available_balance, total_recharge_amount, total_debit_amount, total_income_amount, status, created_at, updated_at from trading.fund_account where user_identity_code = #{userIdentityCode} and account_role = #{accountRole} limit 1
mapper.update: update trading.fund_account set subject_name = #{subjectName}, status = #{status}, available_balance = #{availableBalance}, total_recharge_amount = #{totalRechargeAmount}, total_debit_amount = #{totalDebitAmount}, total_income_amount = #{totalIncomeAmount}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
